intro.vo: Renting in Barcelona has two problems. Listings lie, and speed decides. Thirty-six percent of flats are gone within a day. Chezy is the agent on the renter's side.
intro.title: chezy

brief.label: Brief
brief.subtext: Jessie says who she is; Chezy fills the profile
brief.callout: No form. A profile that follows her.
brief.vo: Jessie is moving to Barcelona for a job at Norrsken in Poblenou. She opens Chezy and says who she is. Instead of a form, the assistant asks the three things it needs: neighbourhoods, budget, bedrooms. Her answers become a profile that follows her into every future chat.

screen.greeting: What flat are you looking for?
screen.assistant1: Welcome, Jessie. Three quick things: which neighbourhoods, your monthly budget, and how many bedrooms?
screen.user2: Poblenou or Sant Martí, up to 2,500 a month, 2 bedrooms, a balcony or terrace.
screen.assistant2: Saved. Poblenou or Sant Martí, €1,500 to €2,500, 2 bedrooms, balcony or terrace, 25 minutes from Norrsken. Anything else that matters?

shortlist.label: Shortlist
shortlist.subtext: Real Barcelona listings, ranked for her
shortlist.callout: Say why a flat is wrong. The ranking listens.
shortlist.vo: Chezy ranks real Barcelona listings against her profile and shows them as cards, price per square metre included. It's a starting point, not a verdict. When she rejects one and says why, no outdoor space, the reason is saved and the remaining candidates re-rank in front of her.

cards.zone: El Parc i la Llacuna del Poblenou, Sant Martí
La Nova Esquerra de l'Eixample, Eixample

forensic.label: Grounded check
forensic.subtext: Every claim points at a listing fact, or says unknown
forensic.callout: Sourced facts. Explicit unknowns. No invented sunlight.
forensic.vo: Now the part listings don't want you to see. Chezy explains a match only from facts it can point at: price, size, rooms, listed amenities. When the listing doesn't say, it says unknown instead of guessing. The first flat lists a terrace and sits inside her budget. It passes. The second is the priciest per square metre, with no floor stated, so that stays unknown. It gets an amber flag. The trap is visible before Jessie wastes an afternoon.

screen.checked: I checked both against the listing data.
screen.amberSummary: 37,5 €/m², the priciest per square metre of the three. Floor and orientation are not in the listing, so they stay unknown.
amberBullets: Precio por m² más alto de los tres
Planta: no consta en el anuncio
Orientación: no consta en el anuncio
screen.greenLine: Grounded check passed: terrace listed, 77 m², within budget.

call.label: The call
call.subtext: Spanish, with the AI disclosure, on the renter's behalf
call.callout: Simulated by default. Live only with her opt-in.
call.vo: Jessie picks the Poblenou flat and asks Chezy to arrange a viewing. Agencies don't answer email, and the call happens in Spanish, during office hours. Chezy's voice agent, authored with unmute and deployed on SLNG over Vonage telephony, opens by disclosing it is an AI assistant, as the EU AI Act requires, names the flat and asks what's available. In this demo the call is simulated: no phone rings unless Jessie opts in to a live call to our own test line. The screen tells the truth about which one happened.

screen.approvalUser: Arrange a viewing for the Poblenou one.
screen.approvalAssistant: Simulating the agency call in Spanish. I'd say I'm an AI assistant. Tick the box if you want a live demo call instead.

transcript.es: Hola, soy el asistente de inteligencia artificial de Jessie. Llamo por el piso de dos habitaciones en el Poblenou.
transcript.en: Hi, I'm Jessie's AI assistant. I'm calling about the two-bedroom in Poblenou.
Is it still available to view?

transcript.es: Sí. Le confirmamos un horario por correo.
transcript.en: Yes. We'll confirm a time by email.

transcript.es: Perfecto, gracias. Quedamos a la espera.
transcript.en: Perfect, thanks. We'll wait for it.

screen.outcome: Simulated · No phone call or calendar booking was made.

handoff.label: Handoff
handoff.subtext: Truthful state: simulated, dispatched or failed
handoff.callout: One conversation. Brief to a call she can trust.
handoff.vo: The result comes back as it is: simulated, or a real dispatch awaiting the agency's confirmation, never a booking Chezy didn't make. Brief, shortlist, grounded check, call, honest handoff. One conversation, and the renter gets an agent of her own.

screen.assistant: Viewing call simulated for the Poblenou 2-bed. Nothing was booked.
screen.status: Live mode: call dispatched · awaiting agency confirmation · request-to-dispatch timing shown.

stack.label: How it works
stack.subtext: Architecture, brand voice, and the agentic loop
stack.callout: The listing works for the agency. Chezy works for you.
stack.vo: Under the hood: a chat surface on Next.js and Nebius, a Postgres store of real Barcelona listings, and an agentic loop that does not stop at answers — it acts. SLNG runs the voice agent, authored with unmute. Vonage carries the call to the agency's phone. Cognition's Devin helped build it, and QualityClouds keeps it honest. The listing works for the agency. Chezy works for you.
